name: True Autonomy ACP-100
summary: Retrofit kit with a 360° lidar that lets an existing push-type concrete polishing machine drive and polish a floor by itself; shown only as a prototype.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. The maker's website has been offline since mid-2022 (the domain now forwards to a host that does not exist). Its last archived pages show a prototype and a contact form, with no price, dealer or customer. No newer source found.

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: retrofit box on an existing concrete polishing machine; the machine can still be pushed by hand

specs.label: Reports
specs.value: when, where and how much floor was polished

notes: The polishing machine is not part of the kit; the kit drives the customer's own machine, so drive and running gear depend on that machine.
Meant for large open floors such as warehouses, polished before racks and equipment go in.
Crews do hand grinding, caulking and cleaning while the machine polishes.

evidence.task: Test run of the autonomous concrete polishing prototype (second of three)
evidence.note: Video on the maker's YouTube channel.

evidence.task: Autonomous navigation and operation of concrete polishing machines, with polishing reports for project managers
